name: The majority voted in favour of *disagreeing* with [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2021-03-22.28.1) introduced by Watson MP [Tony Burke](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/watson/tony_burke) (Labor), which means they failed. MP Burke [explained](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2021-03-22.28.1) that the purpose of these amendments is to: > *bring those wage-theft provisions back into this bill. They do two things. They bring back those provisions, and they make sure that we act on the criminalisation of wage theft.*
